content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Chittaranjan Seva Sadan College Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the form and attach the documents listed above. Send it to Office of the Principal, Chittaranjan Seva Sadan College of Obstetrics, Gynaecology & Child Health, Kolkata, by in person. Attend on 26 November 2026.

content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid to the candidate attending the interview. Each applicant can mention their department in their application.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for Chittaranjan Seva Sadan College Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Chittaranjan Seva Sadan College Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for Senior Resident.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Chittaranjan Seva Sadan College Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 26 November 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS with P.G Degree / DNB from Recognized University.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates will have to perform General Emergency duty as per roster in addition to their department work in the interest of public service.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 3 (three) years subject to renewal after 1 (one) Year according to his/her performance.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Kolkata.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: A resume; Marksheet of M.B.B.S :- 1st Prof., 2nd Prof., 3rd Prof. Part-I & Part-II; Permanent Registration Certificate; Internship Completion Certificate; Degree/Pass Certificate (M.B.B.S); PG Degree Marksheet.
